[spoiler=The Tax Day Riots]

[b]2027/6/1[/b]

Its Tax Day across Lamandica, and Lamandicans are appalled with how high their bills were. Some Lamandicans, who have cut back on luxuries, received a similar or higher luxury tax as previous years. Many Lamandicans searched for answers, but a conclusion was soon reached. Lengthy discussions in private, involving Parliament members from every political leaning, and even as far as Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz had led to the government once again betraying its citizens. Amendment IV of the Lamandican Constitution states, the act of imposing tariffs on the citizenry without the knowledge thereof shall be prohibited unless given consent by the public. The government of Lamandica had breached the document they were sworn to uphold, and now it was time to face the music for it.

Anti-government protests are nothing new in Lamandica. In fact, protests have already occurred in cities like Wichenvidence, Taultion, and Mitremtion since the Horgingtonia debacle. And now there were more violent ones. The first day of widespread protests was June 3rd. Though mainly peaceful, protests did target some businesses with vandalism. These businesses were national corporations, some that invested into Horgingtonia affairs and the petrol stations Lamandica colonized, such as Cieliox, PKI, and RELCO. However, Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz was instructed to send out the National Guard to maintain order. Protests devolved into chaos. Known as the Tax Day Riots, it frequently started when National Guard members would ride down streets and disassemble protestors. In smaller cities like Tiondivesia and Wiscovaichanbair, they would be successful, but they saw more pushback in larger cities. An example of which was in Port Encrastle, when National Guard members forming a line had a standoff with protesters. This event single-handedly made a bad situation worse. After a while, despite not being attacked by the protesters, some officers started deploying tear gas and firing at the crowd with rubber bullets to disperse the crowd. Some even fired real gunshots into the air as a warning. Though some fled, others charged toward the officers. Police started firing their guns into those rushing at them, which led to three deaths and thirteen injuries. The once peaceful demonstrations have now proved deadly.

From June 6th onward, protests became more destructive. Nozzles were ripped out of petrol depositors. Grocery stores looted. Big Box stores set ablaze. An online shipping companys warehouse outside Tewsomah was torched and burned for five hours. Police precincts and government buildings became targets. In Wegaki Bow, Lamandican Police were forced to evacuate their building due to protestors throwing debris and breaching the building. A civilian in Wichenvidence drove into a police line, injuring two dozen officers and a horse. A car dealer stabbed multiple protestors trying to steal inventory in Wiahahleah. The driver of a Cieliox truck was pulled out of his vehicle and beaten on L.H. 1 south of Taultion after trying to drive through a group of protesters on the highway. Outside of Tenahaston, Mitremtion, and General Nueces RELCO locations, petrol depositors were torched, leading to a large explosion that injured two. Unless your commercial building was a small business that didnt support Horgingtonia, your business would feel impacts. Police were helpless as citizens armed themselves with golf clubs, which would be used when one felt threatened. As we reached June 10th, almost ten days after Tax Day, the Tax Day Riots raged on across Lamandica, leaving eleven dead and over one hundred injured. And with limited resources and uncertainty of what could happen next, Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz declared a State of Emergency at 17:00 EET, the first time a nationwide State of Emergency has been issued since 2000. [/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Corporate Monopoly]The Valdderan Government discussed their upcoming order of making Zaibatsu withdrawal from Valddera, the four major corporations originating from the UREV. Hearing the Zaibatsu's demand on leaving, the Valdderan Government completely refuses what they are demanding, as the government realized their economy were getting monopolized while they were barely paying attention, and they won't pay for domestic things on their own land, the government quickly brings on national police and a few divisons of the military to halt any movements by the Zaibatsu companies, they quickly seize the domestic industrial and commercial estates and others. Halting the companies' domestic economical movements indefinitely until they resolve to a solution, Valddera's Government writes down all of the industrial estates and businesses under National property, officially nationalizing it.

That would also lead to a slight annoyed short interview from newly elected Malki of Valddera.
"I can't believe they are trying to violate the sovereignty of the country by Economic Coercion, we will quickly do something about this supposed devilish intent of theirs." Clearly, the Malki wasn't playing around as he declares all domestic properties of the Zaibatsu inside the nation a property of the government. Valddera completely halts down their trade, estates, even buildings and stadiums until whatever the issue is resolved or they talk through "meaningful" negotiations.

This indefinite seizure of the Companies' stuff includes companies like Terran Industries, Antonio Consortium, Orion Corporation, and Amery Holdings. As they halted down their sectors and went in their Headquarters and halted their securities. Valddera's feeling for the companies took a decline, although this was sometimes suspected by the old government that those companies may grow too influential on Valddera, but now it is serious, as now the Zaibatsu were not looking to improve the country or stabilize it, but to monopolize its economy and commit literal Economic Coercion. As the government will not and won't ever let its economy, housing, basic living and technology items and sectors be controlled by mere companies over a nation.

And by those means, the Valdderan Government files a lawsuit against the Zaibatsu companies from 4
The International Court of Justice, the ICJ, claiming in their three articles that they are willing to violate the nation's sovereignty, Article: 1. Committing an Economy Coercion against a sovereign nation and threatening to destroy most of their economy, Article: 2. And threatening to demolish or mass-sell domestic properties needed for living, Article: 3.
The Valddderan Government also sends out a brief short message to the UREV's government to make their supposed four companies withdraw peacefully without any disagreements or things that won't go down will even more.[/spoiler]

[spoiler= The Treaty of Tel Karmiw
[sub]A Land Transfer RP[/sub]]

The Republic of Qartena Hadasht has entered into negotiations with the Republic of Tallisland over the island of Tel Karmiw, the negotiations are centered over the Qartenian acquisition of the island. Many topics have been discussed by the two administrations, chief among them is the issue of religious freedom for the residents of the island. The Republic of Qartena Hadasht is a multi-religious state with worshipers of; Punika, Christianity, Islam, and now with the annexation of the island, Lusandrism. The Republic of Qartena Hadasht has guaranteed that the residents of the islands will be able to continue their practice of Lusandrism, uninterrupted and unimpeded by the Qartenian Government. It will also become a recognized religion in the nation. Places of worship will be exempt from taxes and holidays will be reviewed for incorporation into the Qartenian Calendar. 

Along with the assurance of religious freedom, all residents on the island will be given Qartenian Citizenship, or will be given $5,000 by the Government to assist with their relocation to another nation. This is a part of the "Peaceful Emigration Act" where individuals who live in the new "frontier territories" of the nation were offered assistance to relocate to outside of the Qartenian borders, if they so choose. The Government announced that these offers would be extended to any interested parties who currently reside on the island of Tel Karmiw. 

The Republic of Qartena Hadasht will also respect locally elected authorities, provided that they pass a Qartenian Federal Level inspection. Local elected leaders will be able to keep their post, or will be assigned to a post of equal rank for the remainder of their term. Local First Responders will also retain their employment so long as they pass a mandatory skills test that will be administered by the Adirim of Emergency Management's Standards and Training Division. Those who pass will be given a fast track to acquire First Responder Certifications in Qartena, while those who fail will have to attend the Qartenian Service Academy for their discipline of First Response. 

The Republic of Qartena Hadasht assures the Republic of Tallisland that these individuals will be well looked after and taken care of by the Government of Qartena Hadasht. The Government also advises the Republic of Tallisland to reach out with any further issues they wish to discuss in reference to this matter. 

[/spoiler]

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60985099]Joseph nodded politely, boarded the vehicle and observed quietly, he was not here for pleasantries.[/quote]

The Maglev swiftly transported the men towards the local administrative office, a large brutalist building covered in the flags of Korrin, the Red Sun contrasting heavily with the white exterior of the infrastructure. Joseph was ushered to Cargillis' office and was seated at a large red cushioned chair lined with intricately detailed gold, with the desk being made from imported redwood. A half full glass of whiskey was sitting near the edge of the table and from brief glimpses Joseph could spot documents detailing military production before they were swept away into a drawer.

Cargillis sat down opposite of Joseph, with the four naval officers following the men into the room and standing just a few feet from Joseph. Cargillis brushed the desk for any dust and took a quick sip from the glass, he locked his hands together and pressed down on the table. [i]"Well, mister Joseph, I'm sure you're a busy man with many things to attend to so I won't drag this meeting out, let's get it over quick."[/i] Cargillis paused for a moment and gazed at Joseph to see his reaction.

[i]"I know Rosenmarkke and the rest of Erene are suffering heavily due to this wave of revolutions, and while the rest of the Federation has taken a militaristic approach, your nation has been smart enough to recognise that peace with the Spacenoids is the only way to save an economy. You need resources, Miosul is too much of a hassle to properly exploit, and thus the only reliable stream of metals and such has to come from beyond the belt.

Korrin can provide it, though we won't be sending you our trade ships while the war is happening, you'll have to send us your ships if you want the resources. And in exchange Korrin wants nothing more than cheap food, cheapest as could be. Doesn't matter how bad it tastes, as long as there is enough being sent to us to keep our people alive. The damn Federation tried starving us all in hopes we'd crawl back to them, but luckily Rosenmarkke is truly a noble state."[/i]
